notes.title: New Game
notes.content: [p]The Bicycle Mechanic Simulator BMS sale is just around the corner! We're going to try something different with the event this year. While there will still be an event and rewards, we won't be featuring special trading cards, or any mysterious cards in the lead-up to the sale. Keep your eye out for more details when the sale launches, it should be a fun event.[/p]
